name: Shirakawa Kazui
source:
A lustrous and handsome boy who is a member of the archery club. His hobby is playing the piano. Kazui is popular with both men and women for his soft demeanor and affability.
He also possesses a cunning side that uses others without hesitation for his gain. Kazui loves his younger brother [url=/c16017]Tsuguo[/url] very much.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20050407195831/http://zui.co.jp/products/kashoku/kashoku.html]official website[/url].]
